svg.desc: Onsys Technologies — Role: Full Stack Developer. Software Engineer (2025 Jan - Present); Associate Software Engineer (2024 Apr - 2024 Dec). Worked extensively with Spring Boot, React, and Kubernetes in a microservice architecture environment. Key Responsibilities: Collaborated with product managers to define and implement new features; Optimized application performance and database queries.
